title: L¹ Poincaré inequality for C¹ functions on bounded open convex sets, constant 2ⁿ·diam
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, every open, bounded, convex O ⊆ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), μ = volume) and every w : ℝⁿ → ℝ of class C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1 w): ∫⁻_O ‖w(x) − w̄‖ₑ dx ≤ ofReal(2ⁿ·diam O)·∫⁻_O ‖Dw(x)‖ₑ dx in [0,∞]. Here w̄ := μ(O).toReal⁻¹·∫_O w (Bochner integral), diam = Metric.diam, and Dw = fderiv ℝ w with the operator norm. No positivity of μ(O) is assumed (for O = ∅ the left side is 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (O : Set (Rn n)) (w : Rn n → ℝ), IsOpen O → Bornology.IsBounded O → Convex ℝ O → ContDiff ℝ 1 w → ∫⁻ x in O, ‖w x - (volume O).toReal⁻¹ * ∫ y in O, w y‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ n * Metric.diam O) * ∫⁻ x in O, ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ₑ
